events.title: MTV Launched with 'Video Killed The Radio Star'
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: Remember the day music videos changed everything? 45 years ago, MTV hit the airwaves, kicking off with a track that ironically predicted its own impact.

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and shook up the music scene. What's your favourite track from this absolute classic?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, featuring iconic performances.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago today, the Woodstock Music & Art Fair kicked off, becoming a defining moment for a generation. Imagine being there!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: On this day 49 years ago, we lost The King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to influence music and culture worldwide.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: 30 years ago, the music world lost a legend. Today, we remember Tupac Shakur and his unparalleled impact on hip-hop.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: 56 years ago today, the world lost a true guitar innovator. Jimi Hendrix's sound changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: It's been 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your top pick from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing a very Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' on October 11, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave the world a song to imagine a better future. The message of 'Imagine' still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, Apple unveiled the first iPod, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changing how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 64 years of 007. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor and comedian John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album' – a sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your standout track from this iconic double LP?
